cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Studenti získají znalosti o základních fyzikálních a mechanických vlastnostech potravin. Řešena bude široká škála praktických technických problémů. Studenti získají dovednosti v řešení problémů a hodnocení jevů spojených s mechanickými vlastnostmi a chováním potravin a potravinářských polotovarů.

en.content: Bachelor State Examination
Main quantities, units and definitions, specification of the topic. (allowance 2/2)
Rheology - definition, Deborah's number, basic distribution. (allowance 2/2)
Mechanical properties of solid foods – elasticity and modulus of elasticity. (allowance 2/2)
Mechanical properties of solid foods - strength, fracture toughness. (allowance 2/2)
Mechanical properties of viscoelastic foods - rheological models, constitutive equations. (allowance 2/2)
Mechanical properties of liquid foods - viscosity, methods. (allowance 2/2)
Methods of evaluation of mechanical properties of semi-solid and solid foods. (allowance 2/2)
Mechanical properties of liquid foods - Navier-Stokes equations, numerical methods. (allowance 2/2)
Rheological behaviour of food products - extrusion, coating formation. (allowance 2/2)
Thermal properties, thermal conductivity and heat capacity, methods of their measurement - heat sharing, experimental methods of evaluation, numerical simulation. (allowance 2/2)

Electrical and dielectric properties of food - food quality assessment, sterilization, microwave heating. (allowance 2/2)
Properties of vegetable raw materials and foods (fruits, cereals, vegetables). (allowance 2/2)
Properties of animal raw materials and foods (meat, meat products, dairy products, eggs). (allowance 2/2)
